entities.name: Lossless syntax system
entities.summary: Preserves source structure, trivia, identities, and recoverable errors for tools and elaboration.

attributes.preferred_pattern: immutable lossless green tree with typed red views

entities.name: Incremental semantic query engine
entities.summary: Computes parsing, elaboration, obligations, and diagnostics as memoized dependency-tracked queries.

entities.name: Normalized semantic core artifact
entities.summary: Canonical project-owned representation consumed by checkers, evidence producers, analyzers, and backends.

entities.name: Formal evidence adapters
entities.summary: Translate exact semantic obligations to external proof systems and import independently checkable evidence.

entities.name: Relational analysis plane
entities.summary: Derives recursive whole-project and whole-program relations from normalized facts.

attributes.preferred_pattern: typed fact export with declarative fixed-point queries

entities.name: Optimization bridge
entities.summary: Lowers project-owned IR through optional optimizer ecosystems while preserving semantic correspondence.

attributes.preferred_pattern: project IR with optional MLIR and LLVM adapters

entities.name: Portable component backend
entities.summary: Maps selected external contracts to portable component interfaces and execution artifacts.

attributes.preferred_pattern: Wasm Component Model boundary generated from a semantic contract subset

entities.name: Artifact and evidence distribution
entities.summary: Publishes content-addressed contracts, realizations, evidence, and provenance through replaceable transports.

attributes.preferred_pattern: OCI transport with project media types and signed attestations

entities.name: Semantic attestation profile
entities.summary: Project vocabulary and schemas for claims, evidence predicates, assumptions, subjects, and verification results.

entities.name: Deterministic concurrency simulator
entities.summary: Interprets actor and transaction programs under reproducible schedules for tests, traces, and bounded exploration.

entities.name: Semantic project explorer
entities.summary: Interactive projection of recursive components, contracts, evidence, source explanations, and work dependencies.

attributes.preferred_pattern: thin web client over an introspectable read-only query API

relations.summary: The language system owns source-preserving syntax infrastructure.
Compiler services are organized as incremental semantic queries.
Optimization backends remain behind an explicit lowering boundary.
Portable component generation is a backend rather than the semantic core.
Elaboration emits a deterministic normalized core artifact.
The independent kernel validates normalized core artifacts.
Formal evidence production is a distinct project plane.
Proof adapters consume exact normalized obligations.
Recursive analysis is a derived projection of canonical facts.
Program analysis may import normalized semantic facts.
Lowering begins from a checked project-owned representation.
External interfaces are generated from checked semantic contracts.
Distribution is distinct from semantic package identity.
Distribution attaches project-defined semantic attestations.
Resolution evaluates evidence through explicit project predicates and policy.
The runtime portfolio includes a deterministic testing realization.
The simulator interprets actor semantics under controlled schedules.
The simulator interprets transactional semantics for reproducible exploration.
The explorer renders read-only projections from the project graph and semantic artifacts.
Interactive views consume derived relations rather than owning canonical truth.
